text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Daaahahaha!!
Here we go, from right hereâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golshi-chan WAAAARP!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wha—...!
—Why you...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Why go out of your way to run a path no other Umamusume would ever choose?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Why do you act without hesitation, holding nothing back?
Always doing things that break the mold—

Fenomeno gritted her teeth,
staring at Gold Ship, who had also suffered defeat in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! Golshi, you're hilarious!
Don't go losing out there, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, do your best next time, Golshi--!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ring-a-ding-ding! Ring-a-ding-ding!
Emergency incoming call from Planet Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Take to the skies! Golshi-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon me, pardon me!
Coming through de gozaru~."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Gold Ship-san!?
This is the winner's circle—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I know, I know! Once I borrow that, I'm done!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
That...? Huh!?
H-Hey, give back the mic—!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo... Audience.
There's somethin' I gotta tell ya...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I wuv... evewyone...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well, I love Golshi too, you know!?"
"Me too! Good luck, Golshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Sorry...
Sorry, sooorry, that's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am...
M, A, M, E, C, H,
et cetera spelling, remainder omitted...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I am... Fenomeno...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
What did you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Gold Ship-san.
Could you please give the mic back...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Right!
I'll just leave this here for now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, I'm Mame-chin♪
Fenomeno, in the flesh!♡

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble, call right here!
I'll make sure to unplug the phone line beforehand☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, Golshi, you're so weird!"
"You're not Meno, you're Golshi!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, she...!!
She made such a huge mess
of the winner's circle...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Of all things—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is ridiculous—... Absolutely absurd!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Before the race! During the race!
Trampling over all theories and textbook examples!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every single thing! Absolutely everything—!
—...damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I've got to pull myself together!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You must not use a false name!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Do you know what will happen to the future if such imitations run rampant?! Yes—

text_block_list.name: Kid Who Admires Golshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello? Mom?
It's me. ...No, no! Olé!"

text_block_list.name: Kid Who Admires Golshi
text_block_list.text:
It's me, Fenomeno!
Make sure you leave the bell peppers out of dinner...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Lies running rampant! Utter confusion all around!
Th-this is un-ac-cep-ta-bleeee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The threat Golshi-san poses cannot be overlooked!
I have no time to sit around moping!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't let children be led down the path of villainy!
I refuse to let an outlaw like that
be the only one kids look up to!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wait right there, Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I won't let you become the sole, uncontested favorite Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not going to let you be the only one everyone looks up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if my running lacks flash, even if I'm not popular!
—At the very least, I'll climb to the very top in standing!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The one who will become the Derby Umamusume—is this officer!!

Fenomeno points her finger and makes her declaration.
Her expression was brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, so fun!!
